description: A draft health insurance appeal letter from facts alone, when there is no letter text to paste: addressed for the plan type's appeal level, with a paragraph for the denial reason, the claim-file and new-evidence requests where the rules give them, and blanks for anything not given. Example questions: write my insurance appeal letter; appeal letter template for a denied claim; help me write a Medicare reconsideration request.

internal_appeal_level.description: final = this letter denies an appeal already filed

letter_date.description: Date printed on the letter, if the reader missed it

received_date.description: Day the person actually received the letter, if they say

stage.description: pre_service = prior authorization, post_service = a claim for care already given, concurrent = ongoing care being cut

urgent.description: True only if the person or their doctor says waiting could seriously harm their health. Never infer it.

name: draft_insurance_appeal_letter
title: Draft an appeal letter
